_comment: verify-kani-mutation manifest — the Kani-side analogue of the Lean verify-proof-mutation gate (anti-vacuity for the firmware bounded-verification harnesses). For each entry, mutate a decoder/gate function in a way a specific Kani harness MUST catch, run ONLY that harness, and assert it flips to `VERIFICATION:- FAILED`. A green-when-it-should-be-red = a vacuous / under-constrained harness (the exact failure class the per-slice manual mutation checks caught by hand; this makes them a standing gate — work-todo §34/§35). Paths are relative to the repo root. Every entry uses `expect: kani_fails` (the load-bearing mutation must be caught); the `canary` doubles as the machinery-health check (if it survives, ALL results are void).

mutations.note: verify_rollback always-accepts -> the rollback_boundary biconditional (is_ok() <=> version > floor) MUST break. If this SURVIVES, the harness machinery is broken (kani not running / output not parsed) and every result is void.
the real anti-rollback off-by-one: `>=` would let a version==floor reinstall slip past the OTP rollback floor.
the execute(...) head->tail ABI offset byte; a wrong value = calldata the on-chain wallet mis-decodes into a different call.
perturb the multiSend record-walk cursor advance -> the exact-tiling partition proof MUST break (a hidden byte would ride between records).
excluding Blind from the value-page rule would silently drop a Blind record's non-zero native value -> the no-hidden-value WYSIWYS proof MUST break.
shift a GPv2Order field read by one byte -> the verbatim-offset decode-soundness biconditional MUST break.

disable the per-record op==0 DELEGATECALL-refusal in summarize_packed -> a payload carrying an op!=0 record is now accepted, so summarize_accept_implies_all_call's `Ok => forall record: operation==0` re-walk assertion MUST break. Verified 2026-07-01 by hand: mutation -> VERIFICATION:- FAILED via assert_failed_inner (the assert_eq!(rec.operation, 0) firing), unmutated -> SUCCESSFUL. Closes finding 3b-1's anti-vacuity guard (ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_KANI_2026-07-01.md); the only kani_mutations entry outside the original 4-file curated set.

disable read_address_word_off's top-12-zero address-canonicity reject -> a dirty-padding address word (to/gas_token/refund_receiver) is accepted, so decode_exec_rejects_noncanonical_address (expects NonCanonicalAddress) MUST break. Verified 2026-07-02 by hand: mutation -> BOTH decode_exec_rejects_noncanonical_address AND decode_exec_soundness (accept-direction top-12==0 assert) -> VERIFICATION:- FAILED; unmutated -> SUCCESSFUL. Closes finding 3b/#4 (exec address canonicity had NO harness; deleting the reject kept all 12 safe_tx harnesses green).

disable the dynamic-array element cap (step 7) -> a 9-element sole-tail body is accepted, so resolve_array_rejects_over_cap (expects Reject) MUST break. Verified 2026-07-02 by hand: mutation -> VERIFICATION:- FAILED; unmutated -> SUCCESSFUL. Closes finding §2 #2 (the cap was UNREACHABLE in the symbolic panic-free harnesses at N=160/224 which admit only count<=2/4, so `count<=MAX_ARRAY_RENDER` there was vacuous; the concrete control at 384 B exercises it).

make lookup_enum_label's per-entry key comparison always-true -> the first entry matches any (high-zero) value, so the returned label is entry 0's regardless of which key the value actually matches. enum_two_entry_value_sound (a value matching key1, not key0, must return label1) MUST break. Verified 2026-07-02 by hand: mutation -> enum_two_entry_value_sound (and enum_single_entry_value_sound) VERIFICATION:- FAILED; unmutated -> SUCCESSFUL. Closes finding §2 #3 (the single-entry harness only proved the match where first==correct; the multi-entry return-the-matching-entry property was unverified).

under-report the single-byte item's consumed count (used 1 -> 0) -> ListIter's `&self.rest[used..]` would re-read the same byte (a parse desync). The strengthened `assert_eq!(used, header_len + payload.len())` (header_len derived independently from the RLP prefix byte) MUST break; the old `used <= len` assert would have PASSED with used=0. Verified 2026-07-02 by hand: mutation -> VERIFICATION:- FAILED; unmutated -> SUCCESSFUL. Closes finding §2 #10.
